term_rules.label: Petition the US Tax Court
term_rules.basis: 26 U.S.C. § 6213(a): 90 days after a notice of deficiency is mailed (150 days if addressed outside the United States). 26 U.S.C. § 7503: a deadline on a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday moves to the next business day.
term_rules.notes: Applies to a notice of deficiency. The notice states the last day to file; that date wins. State tax rules differ.

term_rules.label: Cooling-off period (door-to-door sale)
term_rules.basis: FTC Cooling-Off Rule, 16 CFR Part 429: three business days to cancel sales of $25 or more made at the buyer's home or away from the seller's place of business.
term_rules.notes: There is no general federal right to return online purchases; the shop's return policy decides.

annual_dates.label: File the federal income tax return
annual_dates.basis: 26 U.S.C. § 6072(a): individual returns are due on the 15th day of April following the close of the calendar year; § 7503 moves a weekend or holiday to the next business day.
annual_dates.notes: An automatic six-month extension to file (Form 4868) does not extend the time to pay.
